summary: Full-stack testing of CT Winner. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (public GET endpoints with seeded data, auth login/me, 401 protection, CRUD for schedule/events/modalities). Frontend: Home hero, 8 modalities, 3 events, Atividades(8 mods), Horarios(7 days + HOJE badge), Eventos(3 cards), Sobre, Contato(Maps+WA+IG), floating WA button, and admin login→dashboard with Horários/Eventos/Modalidades tabs all render correctly. Admin JWT stored in localStorage and /api/auth/me calls succeed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' (default) is technically invalid per spec; harmless here (JWT in Authorization header) but tighten origins for prod.
JWT_SECRET is read from env with no fallback (good); ensure it's a strong value in production deployment.
No rate-limiting/brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook suggests 5-fail lockout). Acceptable for a simple admin panel but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Not needed — backend auto-seeds 8 modalities, 16 schedule slots, 3 events on startup if collections empty. All CRUD tests clean up their TEST_ prefixed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin token stored in localStorage key 'ctw_token'. JWT 7-day expiry. Login button has data-testid='admin-login-submit'. Schedule/current endpoint returns {day,time,active} where active may be null outside class hours — not a bug.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All features listed in the review_request were verified working end-to-end.
